title: The Frozen Waterfall
text: A waterfall frozen in mid-fall, a great curtain of blue ice hanging from the cliff, every ripple caught. Behind the ice, dim and dark, the shape of a cave mouth. Something has scratched at the ice from the inside.

options.label: Climb the frozen falls, and trust the ice to hold.

outcomes.text: You climb up and over with numb fingers, coming out a long way ahead.
The ice cracks under your hands like a gunshot, and you fall.

options.label: The strongest breaks into the cave behind the ice, to see what scratched.

outcomes.text: Inside lies a hermit's hoard, long frozen, with the hermit still curled up beside it against the cold.
It is a bear's den. The bear did the scratching, and it is very hungry after its long sleep.

options.label: Find the path round, and leave the scratching to whoever made it.

outcomes.text: The path round is slow and cold. The scratching follows you for a while.
